shared_elements: a single decorated register running across a curved surface
justification: A shows purely geometric, incised motifs  oangular grids or net-filled panels framed by concentric curved bands and zigzag borders, with no living forms at all, whereas B shows a row of modelled human figures in relief with raised arms, crouching or dancing, in physical interaction with one another. The only correspondence is the utterly generic fact that each carries a single decorated register across a curved surface, which any tradition could produce independently.
